skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my clips into a YouTube video with intro, transitions, and background...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker for YouTube — Initial Release

- Instantly turn uploaded clips or images into YouTube-ready videos with intro, transitions, and background music in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports file uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and cloud-based GPU rendering.
- Simple prompt-based workflow; no advanced editing skills required.
- Automatic session/token setup with 100 free credits and 7-day expiry.
- Covers common YouTube video workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative preview/refinement.
- Includes error handling, status updates, and export/download functions for high-quality MP4 outputs.
